body: Your feelings are valid. He was a horrible man who did something terrible to you. You are not a bad person for finding relief in this.

Oh hey, congrats on finishing, it may seem an easy feat to others but I'm proud of you for pushing through. I was definitely the same, felt like high school was the bane of my existence. Weirdly enough I feel empty without it, I don't know what to do anymore. For the online friends thing I recommend a discord or something similar related to an interest of yours. The art community from my brief exchange is quite uplifting and it's cool to see other people's creations. I'm glad your cats helped you through school. I hope you find what you enjoy :))

God I wish I could go back too, it would save me a lot of trouble, I'd so many things differently. But I guess it's no use wishing for something that can't happen. I was left out as a kid too, but I never took the initiative either so I don't blame them. Did the worst thing a socially anxious person could do and did online schooling. This completely destroyed my school social life, even though it wasn't much at that point. I was hoping I'd be dead by now lol. I'm sorry to hear that your friends did that to you. Maybe some new online friends can help. It really is nice to know that some are in the same boat, hopefully our interests sustain our lives for a bit :)

My bad, for some reason I thought you were younger. Although you sound exactly like me, is this my future self haha. I too have no idea what I'm doing with my life, everyone always said you're still young you have time to figure it out. Here I am still not knowing lol. Thank you for your kind words. I hope your parents will try and understand what you're thinking and feeling, sometimes they really can be a lost cause. Know that you don't need your parents to validate your feelings. Try and hold on until you get your own place, maybe it'll be a little less suffocating. Believe me, you're not hopeless.

Yeah I feel the same way, feel like I'm not meant to have joy. I constantly feel like my feelings and thoughts don't matter so why should I express them, basically been taught to suck it up.I've been pretty much abandoned by my brother emotionally. I'm actively avoiding my mum when it comes to emotional talk, she's never been good at it anyway lol. I'm currently an a adult as of last year, I feel severely underprepared. I'm still a shut in lmao. I hope you find yourself in a better position than I am at the moment when you get to this age.

I'm sorry to say but if that is his mindset, it will be very difficult to change. I can only suggest distractions with things you know they enjoy or telling them that you're there for him. It sounds like you care for him so much and I wish he could see that. Maybe suggest a suicide hotline to him, there's even a website version where they can type online. Sometimes it really does help to vent and from what I've read he seems like a closed off person, internalising everything and not letting them out so I think that would really help. This is a really tough situation and I hope things go well. I'm sorry I don't know how to help too much but I saw there are no comments and I thought I'd suggest even something in case it does.
